title: NASA Exoplanet AI
summary: A neural network built from scratch in C++ that classifies Kepler, K2 and TESS objects as confirmed planets, candidates or false positives.
detail: 74.2% balanced accuracy on held-out stars, trained without ML frameworks: data pipeline, layers, optimiser and evaluation are all written by hand.

title: Drone swarm “Like Bees”
summary: A concept for an autonomous swarm of about 50 drones with communication and pathfinding, and the Vector logistics and firefighting concepts for Cyprus.
detail: Grew into Vector: drone delivery and fleet sites with a mission control preview, pilot plan and pricing.

title: Neuron
summary: An offline cognitive AI architecture that combines perception, memory, emotion, logic and central control, with a physical body driven through Arduino.
detail: Runs without a network: every module, from memory to decision making, lives on the local machine.

title: SplitBill
summary: QR bill splitting for bars and restaurants: staff add the table order from a terminal, guests scan a QR code, claim their items and get a personal bill.
detail: Terminal, guest and session views with live updates through Supabase.

title: LELP
summary: A reusable lunar platform that collects regolith and launches small return capsules with an electromagnetic launcher.
detail: MVP concept, feasibility study and requirements, presented as an interactive Three.js site.

title: Web development
summary: Product catalogues, landing pages, investor sites, 3D experiences and mobile-first prototypes, including a clinic site with a 3D tooth that turns on scroll.
detail: Most are hand-written with no framework, so they load fast and host anywhere.

title: Secure Telemetry & Internet Relay
summary: Sender, relay and receiver with authenticated delivery, acknowledgements, offline buffering and duplicate detection.

title: Sound-to-Action
summary: Local voice commands with a temporal convolution and GRU model, voice identity checks and a Russian-English benchmark.

title: Zhelezyaka
summary: A mostly local JARVIS-style assistant with persistent memory, its own character, specialised agents and a permission layer.

title: Automata Theory Lab
summary: Finite automaton simulators with state paths, transition diagrams and a DFA state-equivalence checker.

title: Face and Voice Recognition
summary: Identifies people by face and voice, keeps profiles and learns new ones on its own.

title: Automatic Mafia
summary: Registers players from a camera, keeps stable numbers and identities, and hosts a mafia game with a public board.

title: Voice Generator Workspace
summary: Runtime text-to-speech and a training track for building a custom voice model.

title: Oneix Store & SaaS
summary: A catalogue of ten small SaaS tools, each with its own product page.
